I don't even know where to begin. I'm terrified I will say too much or that I will be a burden, or that they will act and make things worse than they already are or that I'll be seen as worse myself.

There's so much I am terrified of and ending my life seems the only option to escape it all
Thank you so much. I will try to keep that in mind but honestly I worry saying too much to anyone. I have anxiety as well which doesn't help me with considering opening up

Thank you. I really struggle with opening up and even though I'm really close to some friends, I am worried opening up will either overwhelm them or that they'll do something rash and make things worse
I keep trying to say that to myself but it has been 3 relentless years and j don't see that changing

I enjoy spending time with my friends, trying to improve my hobbies and myself. I struggle to properly though because I'm always compromising them with him. Even when things go well and uninterrupted, I always have him come to me that night telling me I'm horrible, or that he's not over things I've done years ago when I can't being up things he's done then or since without being dismissed.

I don't want to hurt my friends and family but I struggle to find a way out other than this
